title: Towards Robust Training Datasets for Machine Learning with Ontologies: A Case Study for Emergency Road Vehicle Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical methods to improve machine learning model trust and robustness by ensuring dataset completeness and image quality. While it discusses 'fairness' and 'bias' (specifically representation bias in training data) and provides an example ontology from an 'ethical review board', it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or specific ethical systems.
